prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art animation/state atlas for Agent Office's local task console.
Create a BRAND NEW transparent RGBA square PNG with an exact TWO BY TWO equal-quadrant grid. Each quadrant contains the SAME complete compact standing retro computer terminal, seen from a shallow elevated FRONT view, centered with 15% transparent padding on every edge. The four silhouettes, heights, camera, keyboard positions, feet and color palette must match exactly. The only differences are the screen pixels and a tiny status lamp. This is for a cozy pixel office in navy, cream, walnut and sage green. Very crisp chunky pixel clusters, dark navy outlines, restrained 3-tone shading, no blur, no photorealism. The whole terminal should read at 24 wide by 34 high logical pixels. A cream rounded-square CRT monitor on a short walnut podium, dark teal screen, small cream keyboard ledge, sturdy feet. No cables or extra props.
TOP LEFT: idle console, mostly dark teal screen with a tiny pale mint horizontal cursor, small neutral cream status light.
TOP RIGHT: running console, screen has three simple mint horizontal progress bars of different lengths and a mint status light. No words or numbers.
BOTTOM LEFT: finished console, screen has one modest mint check shape on dark teal, pale mint steady status light. Same unchanged terminal geometry.
BOTTOM RIGHT: disconnected console, screen very dark charcoal and tiny muted gray status light, monitor and podium otherwise unchanged.
Constraints: FOUR complete separate terminal sprites, no object crossing canvas midlines, generous transparent gaps, same size and grounded baseline within each equal cell, consistent viewpoint. Real transparent background with zero-alpha outside silhouettes; no checkerboard or floor, no ground shadows, no glow rays, no particles, no labels/text/watermarks/logos. This is entirely original artwork; no external product artwork or sprite pack is being referenced.
reference: Original artwork generated from a written prompt. No external image or product artwork supplied.
normalization: Preserve the source PNG. Trim each equal quadrant at alpha > 32 and normalize once to a 24 × 34 logical canvas using nearest-neighbor sampling. Collision and placement continue to use the existing taskterminal logical dimensions.

state_semantics.idle: The optional local runner is enabled and connected with no recorded runs, or its newest completed run was cancelled or interrupted.
state_semantics.running: At least one local process reports status running. Cancellation and shutdown remain running until the process is reaped.
state_semantics.finished: The newest completed local process exited successfully; this does not claim its work was reviewed or verified.
state_semantics.disconnected: The optional local runner is enabled but its capability endpoint is disconnected.
state_semantics.failed: A newest failed exit uses the neutral idle source cell with one steady coral error lamp; older successes cannot override it.

fallback: If this atlas is unavailable, taskterminal uses original signals-atlas.png artwork. Routing remains based on the local-run capability: enabled opens Local runs; disabled opens Reported tasks.

visual_review.method: Rendered through the actual scene in Chromium after runtime alpha trimming and nearest-neighbor normalization.
visual_review.result: All four normalized states are distinct and readable at 24 × 34. The terminal stays grounded inside its existing collision box on desktop and mobile with no overlap or clipping. The running state adds only a two-frame activity lamp, which freezes with Pause and reduced motion.
